title: Common providers: Luxembourg
coverage: Partial. Covers the incumbent, the three mobile network operators, cable, and the business ISPs with a network of their own that were confirmed; the regulator's list of notified operators was not read.
missing: Operators on the regulator's list that are not named here (the list was not found on the pages read)
Local cable networks of the communes
A website for LuxNetwork (it did not answer)
An announced AS number for LuxConnect (AS44818 is registered to it and was not announced on the read date)

sources.name: ILR (Institut Luxembourgeois de Régulation)
sources.terms: No reuse terms were found on the front page or on the legal information page on the read date: nothing is copied.
sources.result: The front page answered on the read date; the list of notified operators was not found. It is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in Luxembourg
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 0 of 10 candidate names were found on the page (the name as listed; other names of an entry were not looked up).

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 9 of 10 websites answered one plain automated request; an address that did not answer, or that refused it, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 10 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: RIPE Database full-text search (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The database terms were not read on the read date: nothing is copied. Searched by company name to find candidate AS numbers; each was then confirmed as the entries above and below say.
sources.result: Candidate numbers found for some providers; none was taken without the confirmation.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.
